content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a deputy director-general position at the International Atomic Energy Agency. Tell about your experience in nuclear safety, nuclear technology monitoring, and implementation of the Non-Proliferation Treaty. Also describe how you have promoted nuclear non-proliferation and peaceful use of nuclear technology. Length about 400 words.
